target: Next-session standardized performance in consenting adults familiar with resistance exercise; no injury-safe dose claim
predictorFreeze: Freeze exact current heuristic and an explicit feature-only candidate before collecting outcomes. All predictors recorded before the session.
primaryOutcome: Within-person change in standardized task performance from a prespecified familiarization baseline; fix task, load, order and timing before enrollment.

design.participantSeparation: Development and held-out people separated before fitting; report performance on entirely held-out people.
design.timeSeparation: Within-person forward blocks; no random session split, future smoothing or outcome-derived baseline leakage.
design.confounding: Prespecify task practice, training history, recent load, time of day, illness/medication and missingness; do not pool unmatched tasks.
design.uncertainty: Participant-cluster intervals; choose sample size from clinically/research-relevant precision and pilot variance before enrollment, not a guessed power claim.
design.decisionValue: Prediction is separate from benefit of acting on advice; any intervention needs a separately governed randomized comparison.

adverseUse: Exclude active pain/illness and clinical populations from this first performance study pending appropriate review. Do not instruct participants to follow set bands or override symptoms. Adverse events reviewed by qualified study personnel.
noGo: No direct validation of exact thresholds/set bands currently available; retain only educational reflection and inspectable legacy arithmetic.
approvalAndRights: No recruitment, contact, participant data collection or intervention has been performed. Appropriate consent, ethics and data rights required before enrollment.
